Title: Puzzle halls and a puzzle route button
Changes: Puzzle maps are now enclosed halls: each room has walls, a ceiling, torches and a door that opens when you solve it, with a short corridor to the next room and a camera that stays inside.
Guards in puzzle rooms no longer walk through crates, mirrors, bells and other pieces.
New PUZZLE ROUTE button beside the route on the PLAY page and in the CO-OP lobby: one press turns the puzzle route on, another returns to the route you had.
Puzzle halls have stone, brick and timber surfaces instead of flat colours, and each kind of room has its own look.
The puzzle title card fades sooner, so it no longer covers the first door and its prompt.
Co-op protocol 16: all players must update together.
